_: The battle pickers' stills (tools/battle-thumbs.mjs): per battle, over the default, when to take it and how. time: s of the battle at least. focus 'clash': on until two foes stand within `close` m (the thickest press of them: the pair with most men near), `hold` s more, never past `limit` s; 'red' or 'blue': that side's man nearest its middle at `time` (with `front`, its man nearest a foe; `man`: the nth such instead). yaw: rad round from side-on to the clash's line. distance: m out; height: of the eye, m over the man's floor; aim: the height looked at; fov: deg. seed: another cast. stage: a Level Mode stage's key (its card's still), its player stood at `at` ([x, y, z]) facing `facing` rad, its men left to come to him.
